payload.posture: Read John 15:26–27 as one movement in Pentecost, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states jesus says the Counselor from the Father will testify about him, and the disciples also testify because they have been with him from the beginning. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Pentecost.
